claims.proves: Quick reports are target-scoped (own tests, no borrowed skills count); full reports produce all six phases with memory-recall and research queries naming the target; and phase_2 availability is consistent with the number of recalls that actually answered.
claims.does_not_prove: That recall/research RESULTS are relevant or correct, that doc-drift findings are true positives, that the best-practices audit is complete, or that a passing report means the target project is healthy. Paths are pinned to this machine.
